s: If these validators were to be compromised or act maliciously, it could result in network disruption, loss of funds, or other adverse effects that could materially impact the value of our HYPE token holdings. ​ HYPE is subject to technological obsolescence, including competition from emerging blockchain and artificial intelligence protocols, which could have a negative impact on the price of HYPE and adversely affect the value of our HYPE holdings.

Advancements in AI and blockchain technology are likely to accelerate the development of such protocols, including the development of additional networks that natively integrate AI into consensus mechanisms and other core features.
